name: SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEW
shortDescription: Show the definition and deployed artifacts of one materialized view
description: Show the metadata recorded for one materialized view: its source tables, refresh frequency, delay, the transforms, ingest pipelines and enrich policies it deployed, and whether automatic refresh is available. Requires the Materialized Views extension (softclient4es-extensions) on the engine that executes the statement: an engine without it rejects the statement at execution time with `Unsupported table DDL statement`.

examples.title: Show one view
examples.description: Inspect a view's definition and artifacts

examples.title: Quoted view name
examples.description: A view name may be double-quoted or back-quoted

notes: Requires the Materialized Views extension - an engine without it parses the statement and then rejects it at execution time
IF EXISTS is not accepted here - the parser rejects SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS view_name
Use SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS (plural) to list every view
